newsitem.title: USA: Ecolab forms professional products division.
newsitem.headline: Ecolab forms professional products division.

text.p: Ecolab Inc said Wednesday it combined the resources of its recently acquired Huntington Laboratories business and Ecolab's janitorial division, including the Airkem Professional Products business, to form the Ecolab Professional Products Division.
The new unit will offer customers infection control, general purpose, skin care, floor care, hard surface sanitation and odor control products and systems.
Ecolab said Huntington and Airkem will retain their product identities within their respective markets.
